## Run 47 complete — backend API re-verified, converged

**Result: 0 broken endpoints, 0 code fixes** (7th consecutive converged backend run).

### What I did
Rather than hand-curl from scratch, I ran the existing standing probe suite (already in the tree from prior runs) which covers the full route surface across all 38 `server/src/routes/*.js` files — more exhaustive and reproducible than ad-hoc curl.

| Probe | Coverage | Result |
|---|---|---|
| uncovered-get | 63 GET routes | 62 <500, 1 intentional 503, **0 5xx** |
| gaps | onboarding/payments/props/wo | all 400/404 validation, **0 5xx** |
| edge | malformed json, bad uuid, sql-inj, no-auth | **0 5xx** |
| write | 36 empty-body POSTs | 3×200, 33×400, **0 5xx** |
| tenant-isolation | 22 cross-tenant injections | **22/22 OK** (all ignored) |
| type-fuzz | 1026 payloads | **0 5xx** |
| patch-delete | 10 DELETEs on missing ids | all 404, **0 5xx** |
| happy-write | valid PATCH lead/estimate/invoice | **3/3 → 200** |

**~1,180 requests, 0 unintentional 5xx.** The only non-200s are intentional by design: skip-trace `503` (no `TRACERFY_API_KEY`) and auth `429` (rate limiter). Tenant isolation is solid — `tenant_id` injection via query/body/`X-Tenant-Id` header all ignored, foreign ids → 404, non-platform-admin → 403. Error handling consistent (bad uuid → 400, malformed json → 400, missing fields → 400 with Zod details).

### No commit
Per the QA charter ("if it works, leave it alone") and the "commit after every **fix**" instruction — there were no fixes, so nothing to commit. Working tree only has the pre-existing untracked checkpoint artifact `claude-overnight-20260615-s1-api-test.json`.

### Deliverables updated
- `C:\tmp\api-test-results.txt` — full Run 47 results table
- `overnight_resume.md` — Run 47 section added at top
- `MEMORY.md` — Overnight Runs pointer updated

### For the next run
The backend has converged (Runs 41–47). **Stop re-testing it.** The highest-value untouched gaps are all frontend: tablet-768px sweep of non-Dashboard pages, a11y/axe-core (never attempted), keyboard nav (never attempted), and the frontend page-list visual walk.
